title: Fix Drag Handle Hover Emphasis On Buttons
description: When hovering over UI elements, all active child elements such as labels, icons, and drag handles should be emphasized together. Drag handles on buttons (panel tabs, pane chrome toggles, mode-dock tabs, etc.) currently stay muted because DragHandle sets its own text-muted-foreground and does not follow the parent hover-scope emphasis. Fix so parent hover emphasizes the grip the same way as the label/icon beside it, while keeping handle-only hover (data-handle-hovered) behavior intact.
summary: Drag handles on buttons stayed muted on parent hover because DragHandle paints its own text-muted-foreground and cannot inherit hover:text-emphasized. Added CSS [data-hover-scope]:hover [data-slot="drag-handle"] { color: var(--border-emphasized-color) } so grips mirror label/icon emphasis whenever the pointer is inside the hover-scope. Extended the shell-border CSS vitest and added a pane-toggle markup guard. Handle-only hover (data-handle-hovered) is unchanged.
